verdict.rationale: Martin's docs have a dedicated background-tasks section covering autonomous work: scheduled daily/weekly briefings, proactive email drafting and sending, automatic email labeling with follow-up actions, scheduled wake-up calls, and cc-to-schedule meetings. Reminders and custom multi-step shortcuts add to this. missing for 10: evidence that users can define arbitrary custom automations (triggers or schedules) beyond the preset background tasks, detailed configuration docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the background tasks running reliably.
